rule: One extremely broad curated container cannot outrank several independent governed matches.
expected_invariant: governed_multi_family_score > broad_curatorial_only_score; raw curation remains diagnostic only

rule: A duplicate representation of one source fact cannot add affinity.
expected_invariant: single_source_fact_score == cross_representation_duplicate_score; contributions are identical and the derived representation is exposed as ignored

rule: Shared unknown, missing, or not-governed states add zero default affinity.
Adding an independent high-information match cannot reduce affinity.
Adding an unrelated broad curated feature cannot materially increase affinity.
expected_invariant: score_delta == 0 while the isolated raw-curation diagnostic changes

rule: A same-source match alone cannot overwhelm Context or Spacetime evidence.
A support-1 or support-2 observation cannot create an unbounded contribution.
expected_invariant: score remains in [0,1], low-support contribution is capped, and several governed matches outrank one broad curatorial-only match

rule: Symmetric-task scores are invariant to pair reversal.
expected_invariant: score(left,right) == score(right,left) and family profiles are equal

rule: Query-conditioned asymmetry is declared and reproducible.
expected_invariant: forward != reverse, repeated_forward == forward, and symmetric == false

rule: Removing an unavailable family changes comparability and cannot be silent.
expected_invariant: comparability ratio falls and the unavailable family is explicitly named

rule: An object is excluded from its own candidate list and score path.
expected_invariant: self is absent for CG-CUR-1..6 and direct self scoring is rejected

rule: Duplicate titles remain separate public identities.
expected_invariant: same title plus distinct public IDs yields two indexed, mutually retrievable identities

rule: Geographic layout or map-coordinate distance contributes zero.
expected_invariant: coordinate changes leave index hash, score, and contributions unchanged

rule: A universal broad source or container hub cannot remain undetected.
expected_invariant: near-full fanout plus concentrated deterministic top-1 occurrence raises a hub signal

rule: Seeded randomness contributes zero to candidates, scores, and comparability.
expected_invariant: different global random seeds produce identical candidate and profile hashes
